redfin.remarks: Step inside this stunning 2-bedroom, 2-bath condo with a spacious loft - easily serving as a 3rd bedroom, home office, media room, or creative studio to suit your lifestyle. This home offers an impressive 1,783 square feet of light-filled living space in one of West Los Angeles' most sought-after neighborhoods. With coveted southwest exposure, 16-foot ceilings, and an open, airy floor plan, this home is filled with abundant natural light throughout the day, while all-new upgraded windows keep it quiet and energy efficient. The beautifully remodeled kitchen is designed to impress, featuring quality finishes, a gas range, and a layout ideal for both entertaining and everyday living. Both bathrooms have also been tastefully updated, creating a stylish, move-in-ready interior. Outside, enjoy not 1 but 2 private outdoor spaces: a balcony off the main living area and a rare private rooftop patio - the perfect spot for morning coffee, sunset views or soaking up the Southern California sunshine. Convenience is equally impressive, with 2 rare side-by-side parking spaces next to the elevator, a private secured storage unit, and community bike storage - premium amenities that are increasingly difficult to find in this highly desirable location. Ideally positioned near Santa Monica, Century City, Brentwood, and Culver City, you'll enjoy easy access to renowned dining, boutique shopping, parks, entertainment, and the beautiful beaches of the Westside. With generous living space, high-end upgrades, and an unbeatable location, this exceptional home offers the very best of West Los Angeles living.
